QuestInfo.name: [Ludibrium] Grandpa Clock's Crisis
QuestInfo.1: You took the Pendulum from the broken Doll's House to the abandoned space under the Ludibrium Clocktower and met a fellow named Grandpa Clock. He can fix the clock in the Clocktower, but the evil #bTick-Tock#k is in his way, and Grandpa Clock's time is running out. Bring him the #bMulti-functional Clock Spring#k before it's too late!
QuestInfo.2: I got the #t4031098# from Tick Tock. I need to get this to the #p2040029# before it's too late.
